name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No tropical cyclones in the Atlantic, the National Hurricane Center says
state: The National Hurricane Center reported no tropical cyclones in the Atlantic at its update of 03:23 UTC on 6 Nov (NHC). The non-tropical low south of Bermuda flagged on 5 Nov was moving east over open ocean. The season ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No hurricane threat to land; check NHC and national weather services before travel to the Caribbean.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active or threatening land within 5 days
why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).
